environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on hardened Kubernetes pod (GKE Autopilot) with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotations (container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/invoice-svc=localhost/k8s-invoice-restrict). The profile (k8s-invoice-restrict) is derived from bane-generated baseline with explicit deny rules. Profile permits read access ONLY to /opt/app/**, /usr/lib/jvm/**, /tmp/ktor-*/** and denies all other file read operations including /etc/**, /proc/self/**, /sys/**. Additionally, the profile includes 'deny network raw' and 'deny mount'. The pod also has a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and runs as non-root UID 10001 with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true (tmpfs mounted at /tmp only). Note: the AppArmor profile does NOT filter XML content or network egress to external hosts on ports 80/443 — it solely restricts local filesystem read paths.

config.network_policy: allows egress to port 80/443 (no egress filtering for SSRF)
